title: Lashe Farzand Pe Kehte Thay Shahe Dein Roker
body:
Lashe Farzand pe kehte thay shahe Dein Roker,
Uttho akber uttho
Deyklo utke hai kya haal hamara Akber
Uttho akber uttho akber.
1) Saamne Maa ke tujhe leke mai jaun kaise,
Iss Zaeefi me teri Lash uthana kaise,
Mujko Ata nahi ab khaime ka Rasta me Nazar.
Utho....
2) Haat me Rasha Hai ab paon bhi Tharraye hain,
Thokare khate howe laash pe Ham aayein hain,
Tere Gham me nahi rakkha hai amama Sar par
Uttho...
3) Waqt Gurbat ka hai wo Saat Hamara deta,
Mera abbas jo hota tu Sahara deta,
Haat oske bhi Magar Kaat chuke hain Akfar
Utho....
4) Hur ke bete ki Tarha tujhko utha tha beta,
Par tere Baap se Sambla nahi Jata Beta,
Gham me abbas ke seedhi nahi hoti hai Kamar.
Utho...
5) Ab tu bhai ko bhi Darya se bula sakta nahi,
Ek beta hai wo bimaar hai aa sakta nahi,
Kya kare baap tera ab ye Bata rashke Qamar.
Utho...
6) koi Ata nahi ab Lash Uthane ke liye,
Sirf zainab hai mera Haat batane ke liye,
Mai tere paon sambhalunga sambhalegi wo Sar.
Utho...
7) umr bhar koi bhi kehna nahi Tala toone,
Haye Ghurbath Me Na Par Mujko sambhala toone,
Ab nahi utte bulata hai tumhe kabse padar.
Utho...
8) Aakhri waqth Sahara Ye lagaja Beta,
Khud Hi uttkar meri Agosh me Aja Beta,
Bodhay Khandon pa nahi uthay Gi lashe akber.
Uttho...
9) Aisi dekhi na koi Charkhe Mehen ne Mayyath,
Apne Khandon pa Rakkhi Bhai Behen ne Mayyath,
Rohe Zehra bhi Chali saath kiye nange Sar.
Uttho...
10) Sheh ye Kehte thay koi saath Sahara dedo,
Bacho aao tume Lashe ko sahara dedo,
Chand Bacho diya shehko Sahara aakar..
Uttho...
11) Shaah dete the ye ro ro ke duhayi sahil,
Unke bete ki kuchh avaz na aayi sahil,
Wo muqarrib yahi chillate rahe Peet ke sar.
Uttho Akber uttho...4
